# Listening room

A glass music player with local play state, seek, and track controls. No audio file is implied.

This is an independently authored ZeroSum alternative to the saved reference, not the original 21st.dev author's code. See NOTICE.txt.

## Run

Open index.html in a browser. It is self-contained and runs offline without a server, build step, packages, fonts, images, or network requests. Add ?theme=light or ?motion=reduced for alternate framing.

## Reuse / remix

Import { mount } from './component.js' in a browser module, include style.css, and call mount(element, { theme: 'dark', reducedMotion: false }). Keep the returned handle and call handle.destroy() before replacing the host. destroy restores the host's attributes and original child nodes and removes event listeners.

index.ts and runtime.ts are the editable TypeScript source. They use the same mount(element, options) => { destroy() } contract as the owned GenUI catalog; compile with a DOM-enabled TypeScript toolchain when editing. component.js is the ready-to-use, dependency-free browser module.

Demo data and local confirmation states are examples; they do not call services, play audio, publish, book sessions, or represent real telemetry.
